name: HE Vuhred
zag_role: Non-shrink cements in the construction (introduced by ZRMK), technical observation of the dam
description: ZAG's 2024 book states that ZRMK, the predecessor of ZAG, introduced non-shrink cements in the construction of HE Vuhred, and lists Vuhred among the Drava dams under ZAG technical observation.
history: HE Vuhred is a run of river plant on the Drava in the municipality of Radlje ob Dravi, the third in the chain from the Austrian border. Two units entered service in 1956 and a third followed in 1958, giving three Kaplan turbines of 24.1 MW each. The design flow is 550 cubic metres per second and the head is 17.41 m. The weir has four spillway fields, each 17 m wide, with a maximum discharge capacity of 5,800 cubic metres per second. The reservoir extends 13.1 km at full supply level and holds 10.3 million cubic metres, of which 2.2 million are usable for generation. During the refurbishment the supplier replaced the entire stator winding of generator 3 because the original bars, made to a different technology, overheated. The plant now runs without permanent staff on site.
facts: about 297 GWh, about 12 per cent of DEM output
four spillway fields of 17 m, capacity 5,800 cubic metres per second
13.1 km long, 10.3 million cubic metres, 2.2 million usable

source_differences: Municipality: record 'history' says Radlje ob Dravi, record 'municipality' and the OSM polygon say Podvelka.
Unit rating: record 24.1 MW per Kaplan vs power-technology 24.55 MW nameplate (generators 3 x 30 MVA).

Build dates: record 1956 (units 1-2) / 1958 (unit 3), power-technology: construction from 1952, commercial operation 1956, GEM commissioning 1956. Compatible, unit-3 year 1958 not independently verified.
OpenInfraMap lists 1 generator of 72 MW (OSM tagging simplification) vs 3 units in other sources.

ZAG role: the ZAG book of 2024 credits ZRMK, the predecessor of ZAG, with non-shrink cements for the construction of this plant. Wording in the record that goes beyond that, such as cable duct grouting or ZAG grout formulations, was not found in the part of the book that could be read.
